messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected — elevated 429s and tail latency on multiple endpoints in us-west-2. Affected routes: /v1/chat/generate (50% of traffic), /v1/embeddings (30%), sporadic rerank calls. Auto-alert triggered at 2026-03-17T10:24:50Z.

alex_oncall: saw it. getting paged, joining now. any hot customer reports?

maya_sre: acme-prod reported errors ~10:22. dashboard shows embedding qps spike and chat token latency.

priya_prod: looks like a single route to chat-heavy model variant is responsible for the majority of queueing. rerank calls are amplifying KV cache pressure.

jonathan_infra: suggestion: apply per-route shaping immediately — lower chat concurrency for route /routes/chat/heavy to 20, cap embeddings qps to 60 for non-paid tiers, and disable rerank fallback on that route. can push via infra-cli.

alex_oncall: ok propose live mitigations in order: 1) quick per-route concurrency cap on chat 2) soft-rate-limit embeddings for default route 3) disable rerank for now 4) notify customers. agree?

maya_sre: +1. prioritize minimizing user-visible errors. prefer soft 429 hints with Retry-After instead of connection drops.

jonathan_infra: preparing command. applying now:

```bash
infra-cli apply-rate-limit --region us-west-2 --route /routes/chat/heavy --concurrency 20 --mode soft
infra-cli apply-rate-limit --region us-west-2 --route /routes/embeddings/default --qps 60 --mode soft
infra-cli toggle-feature --region us-west-2 --feature rerank --route /routes/chat/heavy --state off
```

deploy-bot: Executing changeset 3492: rate-limits -> us-west-2. Plan OK.

alex_oncall: I'm handing primary to sam for the next 2 hours while I join customer calls. sam, you're the owner post-change.

sam_shiftlead: taking it. will watch metrics and handle comms. initiating mitigations now.

support-bot: Opened support ticket #INC-9876 for affected customers; initial template: "We are seeing degraded responses for chat/embeddings in us-west-2 and are applying route-level rate limits to mitigate. We'll follow up with ETA."

sam_shiftlead: applied first two rules. rerank disabled. monitoring.

maya_sre: metrics update: 2 minutes post-change — 429 rate down from 12% -> 3% on chat route, embeddings p95 latency down 18%. KV cache miss rate falling.

priya_prod: customer-impact notes: ACME (high), beta-app-42 (medium). ACME uses chat-heavy route; reached out via SSO alert.

sam_shiftlead: messaging sent to ACME SREs, also posted in #support with details and retry guidance.

alex_oncall: thanks. plan next steps: keep limits for 30 min, collect logs for root cause, if stable gradually relax to 40 concurrency and qps 80. prepare postmortem.

jonathan_infra: flag: these are soft limits but we should also schedule a short canary rollback if anomalies persist. will capture config snapshot.

maya_sre: adding eval probes to ensure model variants not regressing under trimmed throughput.

sam_shiftlead: acknowledgements: :thumbsup: will update every 10m or on big changes. ending handoff note.
